title: Iterate the net labels of a schematic sheet
summary: The basic schematic iterator pattern: create a filtered iterator on the active sheet, walk its net labels, collect their display text and destroy the iterator in a finally block.
phrasings: list all net labels on a sheet
loop over schematic objects of one kind
filter a schematic iterator by object type

commands.name: IterateNetLabel
commands.description: List the net labels on the current schematic sheet
